description: Retrospective permission of the erection of 1.00 metre front wall and 1.60 metre columns. Erection of 0.70 metre front wall railings and sliding metal gate to driveway.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 8.1	The proposal, due to the inappropriate design, use of materials, and excessive scale, would result in a bulky and incongruous addition to the site, harmful to the character and appearance of the site and surrounding area, contrary to adopted Local Plan Policy CC1 (Context and Character), CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture), SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposal, due to the inappropriate design and excessive scale, would be detrimental to the safety of vehicles and pedestrians and prejudice the safe functioning of the highway due to insufficient visibility splays when exiting to site and the possibility for vehicles to block the carriageway and/or the footway/cycle lane should vehicles attempt to enter the site whilst the proposed gate is closed. It is therefore contrary to Local Plan Policy EC2 and the Residential Crossovers and Off-Street Parking Policy SPD.
